question: Do clusters built from test-case OAV (the representation prescribed by topic 5) group failed C submissions by the program-level error mechanism, and does label-free execution-deviation evidence recover mechanisms better at the same clustering budget?
claims_not_made: No claim about what any student believed; labels describe program changes, not cognition.
No learning-gain, grading or classroom-effect claim.
No SOTA claim outside this benchmark and its baselines.

data.execution: isolated replay (.cache/cpack-replay-v1): gcc 12.2, -ansi -pedantic -Wall -Wextra, per-test 3 s CPU / 5 s wall, 512 MiB, no network
data.outcome_policy: selected on train-partition agreement with historical verdicts before any mechanism label exists (replay oracle_audit.json)
data.split: research/splits/cpack-v3.json (student + exact-source connected components, seed 42); every derived item inherits the partition of its source submission

real.unit: a failing replayed submission whose same student, problem and year later has a submission passing every test
real.construction: line-hunk delta debugging (ddmin, budget 64 probes) between the failing submission and that later passing one; every probe executed in the isolated runner; the 1-minimal passing hunk subset is classified by token diff and tree-sitter context into the taxonomy
real.primary_gold: status ok, one_minimal true, exactly one category, category != OTHER
real.status: repair-grounded silver labels; the classifier is deterministic and was specified before evaluation; a stratified audit is reported separately and is AI-performed unless a human review is later recorded

injected.unit: one single-edit mutant of an accepted, warning-free program; at most 40 sources per problem, one source per student-year, one random site per category
injected.kept_if: compiles with the historical flags and no warning (the course used -Werror) and fails at least one test
injected.label: the operator category, known by construction

representations.note: block masses fixed here and not tuned; vocabulary fitted on the training partition of the same problem (label-free); values unseen in training map to __unknown__
representations.embedding: qwen3-embedding:0.6b via local Ollama, raw source text, L2-normalised; cosine for HAC
representations.exact_signature: grouping by the identical test-outcome vector (no k)

clustering.cohort: one problem x one partition x one benchmark, clustered transductively

algorithms.kmeans: weighted one-hot (Euclidean), n_init 10, seeds 7/42/91 averaged per cohort
algorithms.hac: average linkage on weighted Hamming (cosine for embeddings)

clustering.k_primary: oracle k = number of distinct gold categories in the cohort, capped by the number of distinct representation patterns; a representation with one pattern yields one cluster and is scored as such
clustering.eligibility: cohorts with at least 6 labelled items and at least 2 categories

metrics.primary: ARI of the cohort partition against gold categories, macro-averaged over eligible cohorts
metrics.identifiability_ceiling: sum over identical-representation buckets of the majority-label count, divided by n: the best accuracy any function of that representation can reach

partitions.train: vocabulary fitting and rule induction only
partitions.validation: development and the single tunable choice listed below
partitions.test: sealed; evaluated once with the frozen configuration

hypotheses.statement: Identical test-outcome signatures mix mechanisms more than deviation OAV buckets: mean ceiling(deviation) - ceiling(outcomes) > 0.
hypotheses.test: paired bootstrap over test-partition cohorts, both benchmarks
hypotheses.falsified_if: 95% CI of the mean difference includes or lies below 0 on either benchmark

hypotheses.statement: Deviation OAV clusters recover mechanisms better than test-outcome OAV clusters: ARI(deviation) - ARI(outcomes) > 0 with oracle k.
hypotheses.test: paired bootstrap and Wilcoxon over test cohorts, K-means and HAC reported separately, both benchmarks
hypotheses.falsified_if: CI includes or lies below 0 for K-means on either benchmark

hypotheses.statement: Evidence OAV (deviation + code cues) beats the strongest pre-existing repository baseline, combined_stdout: ARI(evidence) - ARI(combined_stdout) > 0 with oracle k.
hypotheses.falsified_if: CI includes or lies below 0 for K-means on either benchmark

hypotheses.statement: ILA-2 rules over problem-agnostic evidence attributes (agg:*, code:*) trained on the train partition reach a higher test macro-F1 than ILA-2 rules over the agnostic outcome summary (agg:status, agg:fail_fraction), on the real benchmark.
hypotheses.test: difference with item-level bootstrap grouped by student
hypotheses.falsified_if: CI of macro-F1 difference includes or lies below 0

hypotheses.statement: On the injected benchmark, frozen code-embedding clusters align more with the source program than with the injected mechanism: ARI(embedding, source) > ARI(embedding, mechanism) with oracle k for mechanism.
hypotheses.falsified_if: CI of the difference includes or lies below 0

rule_induction.unmatched_examples: abstain; counted as errors for recall and accuracy

tracks.seen_problems: train partition -> test partition, all problems
tracks.unseen_problems: lab02+lab03 train partition -> lab04 test partition (new problems and new students)

statistics.bootstrap: 10,000 resamples, seed 0, over cohorts (clustering) or students (rules)
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction across H1-H5 Wilcoxon p-values; CIs reported unadjusted
statistics.reporting: every eligible cohort, abstentions and degenerate cohorts listed; validation and test tables kept separate
